dataset: FlyEM MaleCNS v1.0, min confidence 0.5, traced-only (slim LC + compact MB)
normalisation: additive two-segment (graph600a lesson): per-post, edges from channel input cells normalised to sum|w|=1; all other edges to sum|w|=alpha (alpha=1.0). Protects LC→DN drive from bridge/MB dilution.
assumptions: Engineered 8-channel input injection; signed leaky tanh rate units; ACh +1, GABA/Glu -1, modulatory/unknown 0. Additive two-segment weights. Not a physiological whole-brain model.
noteSpeed: Absolute µs measured 2026-10-17 on box under concurrent CEM load; ratio vs 80-neuron on same host is the fair comparison. Historical HANDOVER v1=8.2µs / v600=183.6µs were on a quieter host.
